title: GALE PE TEGH HAI SAJDE ME SURQROO HAI HUSSAIN
body:
GALE PE TEGH HAI SAJDE ME SURQROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
TU SAR KO KAAT KE KYA ZIKR E HAQQ KO ROOKEGA
QURAAN ZUBAAN E SHAIHE KARBALA MAY BOLEGA
SINAA KI NOOK PA BHI MAHWE GUFTUGU HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
1. KHUDA KA NAAM MUSALSAL HAI TA QAYAMAT HAI
BAQAYE DEEN E NABI KI YAHI ZAMANAT HAI
KE SAR SE PAAOON TALAK AB LAHO LAHO HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
3. RUKA HAI JABR O TASHADUD SE NA RUKEGA KABHI
KAREGI HASHR TALAK YE AZA HAR EK SADII
HAR EK SAMT QUDA HAI HAR EK SOO HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
4. KABHI BHI FATWAYE BIDAT TERI CHALEGI NAHI
SADA YE ROH E AZADAR HAI DABEGI NAHI
GALI GALI MAY HAI GHAR GHAR ME KUBAKU HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
5. PAYAAM E AADAM O QATIM USI SE ZINDA HAI
NAJAAT JISME BASHAR KI HAI WO SAFEENA HAI
KUL AMBIYA KI TAMANNA HAI AARZOO HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
6. AZA KE MUFTIYE DOURAAN YE GOONJ BHI SUNLE
KHILAF E MATAM E SHAI LAB KUSHAI SE PAHLE
RAHE YE DHYAAN KE MEHSHAR MAY ROBAROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
7. YEH SABR OR YEH ESAAR HAQQ E SARWAR HAI
MALA HUWA HAI JO RUQQ PAR WO KHOON E ASGHER HAI
HUZOOR E HAQ ME GAYE HAI TOU BAWUZOO HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
8. JO MATAMI HAI YAQEENAN SHARAF HAI YE UNKA
HAR EK SHAI KA AZADAR HO NAHI SAKTA
MILE NA SABKO JO EMAAN KI WO KHOON HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
9. NIGAH E SIDQ MAY SADIQ KHUDA TALAB HAI WOHI
KHAYAM E SAJDAYE MAABOOD KA SABAB HAI WOHI
HAI JISKE DUMM SE AZAANE WO JUSTUJU HAI HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
WO DEKH DEEN E QUDA TERI AABROO HAI HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ: ALI ANJUM SADEQ SAHAB.
